counting: Only complete original tasks count; partial tasks count zero. Equal task count is not an effort or production-readiness percentage.

KAN-001.acceptance: Monorepo, unchanged requirements, branching/mirror rules and decision register; no existing code overwritten.

KAN-002.acceptance: Pending source-available license, third-party inventory and collected notices, explicit trademark/release gates; no false open-source claim.

KAN-003.acceptance: Format/lint CI and repeatable architecture-labelled debug builds for AMD64, ARM64 and armhf, ELF and SHA256 verification.

KAN-004.acceptance: Server/web/native-TV architecture, independent domain/API modules, and explicit Pi/HTTPS/ChatGPT risks.

KAN-005.acceptance: Unit/integration/browser layers, hardware matrix and Pi scenarios, Dev/Beta/Stable gates without invented budgets.

KAN-006.acceptance: Rust service loads persisted settings and environment configuration, reports local errors, starts/restarts on Debian 13 without display or network.

KAN-007.acceptance: Transactional versioned migrations, WAL/FK/FULL, private Unix data/backup permissions, service-account configuration, non-root runtime and integrity checks.

KAN-012.acceptance: Board/column lifecycle, permanent unique prefixes, order/colors/Done and deletion rejection for backlog/archive/trash content.

KAN-013.acceptance: Internal UUID/public prefix-counter identity remains stable across moves/import/restore; counters and issued IDs never roll back.

KAN-014.acceptance: Global optional types, per-board activation, child permission/rank; changing types retains all custom text fields.

KAN-015.acceptance: Central global labels, multiple labels per ticket, global search/filter and unchanged labels after board move.

KAN-016.acceptance: One child level, parent completion closes children, reopening does not reopen completed children, atomic family move and no child detachment.

KAN-017.acceptance: Persistent acyclic graph, blocked completion, deterministic transitive reopening with WIP-safe backlog fallback.

KAN-018.acceptance: Warning/strict WIP, root-only counting, transactional API/batch/concurrent-writer enforcement and reopening fallback.

KAN-019.acceptance: Explicit target column/backlog, activate or convert missing types, children/labels/custom fields/identity retained atomically.

KAN-020.acceptance: One transaction/domain validator for all writers, entity revisions, guarded configuration bases, logical undo/sync groups and atomic failed writes.

KAN-023.acceptance: Left collapsible backlog, rounded toggle, mouse drag, touch-pointer handle, keyboard alternative and visible WIP rejection.

KAN-024.acceptance: Configurable priority score, property/text/label/type/date/importance/status/custom-field filters and sorts; saved views and manual rank survive reload/restart.

KAN-025.acceptance: Settings sections/dialogs, DE/EN, themes/colors; all released settings have shared API reads/writes and guarded stale writes.

KAN-026.acceptance: Immediate Kanlo loading shell, actual loading/sync/error states, no artificial delay; no persistent initial loading decoration; undo toast only for actual changes with undo enabled.

KAN-035.acceptance: HTTPS service worker/app shell, only visited board data in IndexedDB, no authenticated API response cache, LAN HTTP limitation visible; pinned isolated HTTPS offline test.

KAN-036.acceptance: Persistent IndexedDB op IDs and causal temporary-ID mapping, atomic acknowledgment deltas, multi-tab coordination and idempotent repeat without duplicate creation/comments.

KAN-037.acceptance: Saved entity revision/base field values, automatic independent-field merge, explicit base/server/local conflict UI and no silent same-field overwrite.

KAN-038.acceptance: Restore changes epoch even with unchanged content; old queue pauses for review, deleted IDs are not recreated, queues survive reload.

KAN-039.acceptance: 401/session revocation stops external sync, local offline edits survive disconnect/reload, only reauthentication resumes writes; no secrets in cache.

KAN-042.acceptance: Parent-child trash cascade, removed dependency preview, no orphan rows, reference/WIP-validated restore and opt-in retention.

KAN-043.acceptance: Persistent per-board undo 0–1000, grouped multi-step preview/confirmation and stale-history rejection; Undo=0 leaves trash/statistics available. Redo remains outside the agreed initial scope.

KAN-044.acceptance: Flexible interval/day/nth-weekday schedules, timezone/DST handling, after-completion gating, persisted occurrence/anchor across restart and idempotent tick.

KAN-045.acceptance: Complete archive state, search/manual/batch archive, opt-in completion-age scheduler and reactivation/restore with data preserved.

KAN-046.acceptance: Filtered matches become an explicit batch selection, mutation is atomic/revision-checked, mandatory web preview/confirmation and grouped undo; destructive API commands also require preview.

KAN-050.acceptance: Versioned complete board JSON relations/comments/children/labels/custom fields/types/recurrences, roundtrip, restricted formula-safe CSV and explicit import preview/default skip.

KAN-052.acceptance: Full/selective preview and confirmation, safety snapshot, ID/link validation, monotonic identity, new epoch and queue review; unselected board data retained.

KAN-053.acceptance: Separate LAN and protected proxy listeners, actual-peer/Host checks and no Forwarded-header downgrade; direct router and real TLS proxy browser tests.

KAN-054.acceptance: Argon2id storage, secure cookie/CSRF/rate limit, logout/timeout/revocation and actual external browser reauthentication tests.

KAN-055.acceptance: Independent revocable hashed API keys, no secret audit output/backups, immediate revoke, authenticated bulk/restore and restore invalidation.
